name: Adzviser Search Console
description:
Connect your Google Search Console data to Claude. No more exporting CSVs or uploading files, Adzviser brings your search performance data directly into the conversation.

Ask about clicks and average position. Compare landing pages, dig into the queries bringing people to your site, and understand what's changed over time. Whether you're checking last week's rankings or putting together a monthly report, start with a question and let Claude build the analysis you need.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adzviser Search Console to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adzviser Search Console to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://search-console.mcp.adzviser.com/http. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adzviser Search Console MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Search Console provides these MCP tools: list_metrics_and_breakdowns_search_console, list_workspace, and retrieve_reporting_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adzviser Search Console?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adzviser Search Console in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Adzviser Search Console MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Search Console requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adzviser Search Console is developed by Adzviser LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
